text.p: The government is planning to hit Railtrack with a windfall tax of 500 million pounds, according to sources close to the government, The Sunday Telegraph reported.

The paper said it was the heaviest tax any privatised company will suffer in next month's budget. "(Railtrack) is said to have been told by government sources to expect a tax of about 500 million pounds, although Gordon Brown's Treasury team is still working on the final details of the Budget," The Sunday Telegraph said.
"Government sources say that Railtrack has become one of the prime targets because it was sold off too cheaply last year," the paper said.
No-one at Railtrack was immediately available for comment.
